app_id.desc: The ID of the app whose configuration you want to export as a manifest.

desc: Export an app manifest from an existing app. When called with a manager app token, this method can only export apps that were created by that manager app.

errors.app_not_eligible: The specified app is not eligible for this API.
errors.app_not_found: The specified app was not found or has been deleted.
errors.app_not_owned_by_manager_app: The specified app is not managed by the calling manager app. A manager app can only access apps that it originally created via apps.manifest.create.
errors.failed_export: Failed to export manifest for given app ID
errors.invalid_app_id: The app ID passed is invalid.
